StagePseudocode
InputNode table with name, value, optional value2; edge table with paired nodes and WCD; parameters: cluster_by, top_clusters = 5, base_per_cluster = 4, target_n = 20, min_size = 3, intra_delta = 2, inter_delta = 5.
OutputFinal node clusters, leader-follower edges, top-20 sampled nodes, modularity Q, and silhouette statistics.
1Normalize node names and numeric scores.
2Select active FLCA score: use value for maturity mode or value2 for influence mode.
3Sort nodes by descending active score and assign initial unique cluster IDs.
4Normalize edges into Leader, Follower, and WCD.
5For each edge, assign the higher-scored node as Leader and the lower-scored node as Follower.
6For each follower, retain only one strongest leader link using maximum WCD; break ties by leader score and leader rank.
7Identify true leaders as nodes with at least two followers; always retain the top-scored node as a leader.
8Iteratively merge each non-leader follower into its leader's cluster until no cluster assignment changes.
9Detect small clusters with fewer than min_size members and merge them upward through their leader connection.
10If only one cluster remains, split it into two rank-based subclusters to avoid a trivial one-cluster result.
11Renumber clusters sequentially according to the highest active score within each cluster.
12Apply major sampling: rank clusters by size and total active score.
13Select the top top_clusters clusters.
14From each selected cluster, take up to base_per_cluster highest-scored nodes.
15Fill remaining positions by round-robin sampling from selected clusters until target_n = 20 is reached.
16If still fewer than 20 nodes, fill by global active-score ranking.
17Rebuild the sampled edge set using only edges among selected top-20 nodes.
18Compute modularity Q for the final sampled clusters using weighted and unweighted undirected edges.
19Compute silhouette statistics using distance transformed from edge weight: stronger WCD indicates shorter distance.
20Apply intra-cluster and inter-cluster penalties for missing edges using intra_delta and inter_delta.
21Return final clusters, leader-follower relations, sampled top-20 network, modularity Q, and silhouette values.
